LESSON: WRITING 1.4.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING FILLING FORMS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Writing 1.4.1 Functional writing Filling Forms
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 1.4.1 Functional writing Filling Forms, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why should one be careful when filling in forms?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 1.4.1 Functional writing Filling Forms together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: Communication and self-expression as learner creates a form, and then type it on a computer, laptop or tablet

● Digital literacy: Interacting with digital technology as learner manipulates digital devices to download, create and fill and forms.

Values:
● Love: Sharing as learner records, together with their partners the required information related to

the theme.

● Respect :Patience as a learner creates and fills forms with others.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Gender education as learner interacts with content about the various people and genders in the theme of family.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: Why should one be careful when filling in forms?
